content.title: Book Recommendation: Pachinko by Min Jin Lee
content.body:
## Summary
Pachinko by Min Jin Lee is a captivating multi-generational Korean family saga set in Japan.

## Notable Features
- National Book Award finalist
- Follows four generations of a Korean family
- Explores themes of identity, belonging, and resilience
- Historical context spanning Japanese occupation, war, and immigration

## Notes
This sweeping historical novel provides insight into the Korean diaspora in Japan, a perspective rarely explored in Western literature. The narrative follows characters from 1910 through the late 1980s, offering a deeply human story against the backdrop of significant historical events.
